text:
frank: saw an OOM on prod-shard-9 at 04:11 UTC. Not the usual sticky-residency — this looks like a slow accumulation in mid-sized slab classes after heavy repair jobs. quick heap snippet: https://logs.company/oom/1745557777

nora: paste the snippet?

frank: heap.used_mb: 16384 -> 27840 over 6h; kv.resident.count: 1.1M -> 3.9M; slab.mid_bucket.live: 210k -> 970k; gc.pause.p95: 20ms -> 72ms

isabel: slab mid-bucket spike + repair window correlation suggests fragmentation/shadow allocations. i'll own slab-seal and retention profiling. target: identify top retention callsites by Tue EOD.

diego: i'll run GC and free-path experiments (async-free batching, delayed-free throttle). will compare p95 pauses and residency delta. due Thu.

kevin: infra note: autoscaler ignored this because request queues were stable. propose rule: residency.delta_rate > 1.6x over 10m triggers a scale advisory. i'll prototype in staging.

frank: let's list short action lines we can paste into the postmortem tracker. keep them compact.

isabel: Action: slab retention profiling & top callsites -> owner: isabel -> due: 2026-03-26 -> success: top 5 retention sites + PRs or mitigations

diego: Action: GC/free-path experiments (async-free variants) -> owner: diego -> due: 2026-03-28 -> success: identify a config that lowers p95 GC pauses by >=20% and reduces residency growth

kevin: Action: prototype residency-delta autoscale advisory -> owner: kevin -> due: 2026-03-25 noon PST -> success: staging validates advisory triggers for 2 synthetic runs

nora: Action: canary soft-evict with hysteresis and hot-key snapshot pre/post -> owner: nora -> due: 2026-03-27 09:00 PST -> success: <3% errors and measurable drop in mid-bucket residency

frank: Action: add weekly "residency shadow" heatmap job and add to oncall runbook -> owner: frank -> due: 2026-03-24 -> success: job present and alert threshold documented

ops-bot: Created issue: INF-4905 - "Mid-slab fragmentation / shadow residency spike followups" (https://jira.company/browse/INF-4905). Assigned: isabel, diego, kevin, nora, frank.

isabel: i'll attach flamegraphs, slab histograms, and a minimal repro to INF-4905 once profiling completes.

diego: i'll push GC experiment configs to infra repo and tag runs gc-exp-4905.

kevin: staging script for residency delta simulation: https://git.company/tests/kv-residency-shadow. i'll extend it to include repair-job workload.

nora: scheduling 30m sync after canary starts (2026-03-27 10:30 PST) to review metrics and decide next steps. calendar invite sent.

frank: please paste PRs, dashboards, and run-ids into INF-4905. i'll post nightly summaries to #eng-oncall for 7 days.

ops-bot: Incident note appended to INF-4905: "Observed mid-slab shadow residency spike after repair jobs; owners assigned; canary + profiling planned."

isabel: starting slab profiling in staging now. aim to post initial findings by Tue.

diego: kicking off GC experiments.

kevin: prototype deployed to staging, monitoring advisory alerts.

nora: will post canary dashboard link to the issue after 12h.

frank: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in the scheduled sync and then at next retrospective to decide long-term allocator/eviction changes. :calendar:

isabel: ack, will report Tue.

frank: end.
